Oil Prices Surge Amid US-Iran Tensions and Deal Uncertainty

Brent Crude oil prices surpassed $87 per barrel, driven by heightened geopolitical tensions between the US and Iran. Doubts over a potential US-Iran Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) have exacerbated supply concerns, with reports indicating a 64% drop in Strait of Hormuz transit. US President Donald Trump issued a warning to Iran, asserting his role as "Iran's banker" and claiming 100% control over the Strait of Hormuz. Meanwhile, US gas prices have risen by over $1 since the conflict with Iran began, with some reports suggesting potential Iranian threats could be a calculated move to disrupt ongoing negotiations and agreements.
